sources.title: Why Your Team Needs a Quality Gate for AI-Generated Code (And How to ...
sources.snippet: Why does AI-generated code need its own quality gate? AI-generated code fails differently than human-written code. It compiles. It passes tests. It looks reasonable in a 30-second review. But it has structural tells that accumulate into real problems over time: Narrative comments that describe what the code does line by line, instead of why — a sign the model was narrating, not documenting ...
